messages:
Alex R.: Morning — rolling the opcode/abi tweak (runtime-engine v5.1-opcode-shift) into daylight slice 5% in ~20m. quick checklist: smoke, perf, and fallback route. who can own rollback criteria?
Priya S.: I can take rollback. criteria idea: 5m rolling error-rate > 3x baseline OR p50 latency jump > 40% for two consecutive windows. also watch tiny-batch QoS.
David K.: Noted. devex will run small-batch smoke (seq_len=64, batch=1) against canary hosts — sending command now.
Lina M.: Heads up, quant-lite builder produced slightly different matmul path; perf on p99 might be noisy for first 10 mins. we'll rely on perf-env flags.
Jordan T.: added route fallback to runtime-policy: route->v5.0-stable for failing pods. If deploybot sees >10% fail in slice it will auto-fallback. confirm?
Alex R.: yes confirm. ensure deploybot auto-fallback window 600s. also produce a short release-note blurb we can paste into the annoucements channel after stable.
deploybot: Deploy started: runtime-engine@v5.1-opcode-shift -> slice=5% region=us-west-2. monitor: /ops/deploys/1728700000.
David K.: running smoke: ```curl -X POST https://staging-api.internal/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-matmul-v2","prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer dev-token' | jq '.latency_ms'``` will post numbers in 2m.
Priya S.: quick checklist for rollback exec: 1) pin traffic off v5.1 2) unpublish pushcache 3) alert oncall + create incident note 4) mark release note as "aborted". keeping runbook open.
Lina M.: observed: one canary pod OOM'd at ~30s after start on small instance; collecting container logs now. not sure if quant builder artifact.
David K.: logs show matmul kernel mismatch in symbol table, stack trace pointing to librt-opt.so v2 vs v3. possible packaging mismatch.
Priya S.: if packaging mismatch confirmed -> rollback immediately. don't wait for 5m window. tagging severity high.
Alex R.: ok. David/Lina, try `runbook/pack-check` steps and post checksum diff. if mismatch -> execute rollback command: ```/deploy rollback runtime-engine@v5.1-opcode-shift --slice=all```
deploybot: Canary progress: 5% -> 5% (3/3 pods healthy). telemetry: p50 +7%, p95 +12%, errors 0.7% (baseline 0.2%).
Jordan T.: adding an emergency temporary pin TTL=1h on affected hosts if we rollback to avoid redeploy churn.
Lina M.: checksum diff: librt-opt.so sha256: expected `a3f1...9b` vs deployed `b7c2...2f` — packaging mismatch confirmed.
Priya S.: executing rollback now. Alex, I'm initiating and will post incident stub.
deploybot: Rollback initiated by Priya S.: runtime-engine@v5.1-opcode-shift -> reverting to runtime-engine@v5.0-stable. progress: 0% -> 100%.
Alex R.: thanks. postmortem owners? Priya and Lina to lead; David to help with packaging pipeline. I'll draft release-note correction: "v5.1-opcode-shift aborted due to packaging artifact mismatch causing runtime kernel symbol conflict; rollout halted and v5.0 restored."
Priya S.: opening incident: INC-1728701. short-term action items in the incident doc. long-term: add preflight checksum gate into deploybot pipeline + enforce artifact signed manifests.
David K.: I'll add checksum gate to next CI job and run a sweep of all recent builds to spot any other mismatches.
Jordan T.: leaving a note for next change window: switch default test matrix to small-batch smoke to catch kernel symbol mismatches earlier.
Alex R.: good work everyone. I'll post a brief to #eng-releases after incident note finalized. :thumbsup:
